info.title: Flexera Cloud Cost Optimization Bill Upload API
info.description:
You can use this API to upload bills to Flexera.

Before you can upload bills, remember to create a CBI Bill Connect using the [Flexera CBI Bill Connect API](https://reference.rightscale.com/optima-bill/#/CBIBillConnect).

The API is available at the following endpoints:
* (NAM) https://api.optima.flexeraeng.com
* (EU) https://api.optima-eu.flexeraeng.com

Important: The billing period (yyyy-mm) is the unit of ingestion. When a bill upload is committed and processed for a billing period, it replaces that month of data for the given bill connect and org. This API is not designed for daily incremental uploads; to change a month, upload the full month and commit again.

To remove existing billing data for a month, overwrite it by committing a new bill upload for the same billing period that contains no cost rows (for example, a CSV file with only the required header columns and no data rows). Note: a bill upload must contain at least one uploaded file to be committed.

Default limits (to override those, talk to your Flexera account manager):
* Up to 500 files max per bill upload;
* Each file must be at most 1000 MB;
* 120 seconds "cool off" period between bill upload creations, for a given bill connect and billing period.

## Auth
Requests made to the API must be authenticated using a token obtained from the [Cloud Management API](https://docs.rightscale.com/api/general_usage.html#authentication).
An "API-Version" header must also be set; the current version is "1.0".
The API actions below list privileges (aka security scopes) required to access that particular action. Privileges are granted by
roles in the [user governance application](https://docs.rightscale.com/cm/ref/user_roles.html).

For more detailed information on roles, see [policy access control](https://docs.rightscale.com/policies/#access-control).

get.description:
Lists existing bill uploads. You can filter by bill upload and/or billing period, too..

**Required security scopes for JWTAuth**:
  * `optima:bill_upload:index+optima:bill_connect:index+common:org:own`

parameters.name: billConnectId
parameters.description: Optional filter by bill connect ID

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: The relevant organization for the bill upload(s)

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: JWT token used to perform authorization

post.description:
Creates a new bill upload, for a given [bill connect](https://reference.rightscale.com/optima-bill/#/CBIBillConnects) and billing period (month, yyyy-mm). Committing and processing a bill upload replaces that month of data for the bill connect/org.

**Required security scopes for JWTAuth**:
  * `optima:bill_upload:create+optima:bill_connect:create+common:org:own`

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: The relevant organization for this bill upload

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: JWT token used to perform authorization

get.description:
Shows the details of a bill upload, including the list of successfully uploaded files so far.

**Required security scopes for JWTAuth**:
  * `optima:bill_upload:show+optima:bill_connect:show+common:org:own`

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: The relevant organization for the bill upload

parameters.name: billUploadId
parameters.description: The identifier of the bill upload

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: JWT token used to perform authorization

delete.description:
Deletes a bill upload, provided  it is in the aborted state.

**Required security scopes for JWTAuth**:
  * `optima:bill_upload:delete+optima:bill_connect:delete+common:org:own`

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: The relevant organization for the bill upload

parameters.name: billUploadId
parameters.description: The identifier of the bill upload

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: JWT token used to perform authorization

post.description:
Uploads a file, adding it to the given bill upload.
Note, by default, you can only upload 500 files max per bill upload, and each must be smaller than 1000 MB.
If the upload is successful, a MD5 hash is returned, so that you can verify its integrity.
        

**Required security scopes for JWTAuth**:
  * `optima:bill_upload:create+optima:bill_connect:create+common:org:own`

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: The relevant organization for this bill upload

parameters.name: billUploadId
parameters.description: The identifier of the bill upload

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The basename of the uploaded file (100 characters max), supported extensions: .csv, .json, .jsonl, gzipped or not

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: JWT token used to perform authorization

post.description:
Performs an operation (i.e. commit or abort) on a bill upload. Committing triggers processing of all uploaded files and replaces that month of data for the bill connect/org; aborting closes the upload and any uploaded files will not be processed.

**Required security scopes for JWTAuth**:
  * `optima:bill_upload:create+optima:bill_connect:create+common:org:own`

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: The relevant organization for this bill upload

parameters.name: billUploadId
parameters.description: The identifier of the bill upload

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: JWT token used to perform authorization

FileResponse.description:
The file resource is a sub resource of bill uploads and represents a single billing file that has been uploaded for a bill upload.
                 The resource tracks the success of each upload as well as the file signature of the uploaded file,
                allowing the client to validate that an upload was successful. (default view)

JWTAuth_header_Authorization.description:
**Security Scopes**:
  * `optima:bill_upload:create+optima:bill_connect:create+common:org:own`: Allows creation of bill uploads, files and operations
  * `optima:bill_upload:delete+optima:bill_connect:delete+common:org:own`: Allows deletion of bill uploads
  * `optima:bill_upload:index+optima:bill_connect:index+common:org:own`: Allow indexing of bill uploads
  * `optima:bill_upload:show+optima:bill_connect:show+common:org:own`: Allow viewing of individual bill uploads
  * `cm:legacy:enterprise_manager+common:org:own`: Partner access
JWTAuth_header_Authorization.name: Authorization
